name: oh-my-zz
description: A focused engineering skill pack for one-question-at-a-time idea grilling and refinement, implementation plans with inline requirements and optional specs, brief change plans, secure session handoffs, opt-in project-memory discovery, proposal-first architecture synchronization and separately approved hard-rule maintenance, and root-cause simplification of code and project-memory documentation, plus evidence-grounded systems paper writing.

interface.shortDescription: Eight focused workflows for plans, memory, root-cause simplification, and systems paper writing.
interface.longDescription: An eight-skill engineering workflow pack for grilling and refining ideas, creating implementation plans with inline requirements and optional specs, planning brief changes, handing off sessions, maintaining project memory, and simplifying code and project-memory documentation, plus writing evidence-grounded systems papers.
